host.binary_distribution: bundled with the installed ChatGPT desktop app; the desktop UI itself was not tested

installation.scope: user-wide in a fresh disposable local profile
installation.command: npx --yes skills add NemuKei/zero-base-thinking --skill zero-base-thinking --global --agent codex --yes

checks.observation: The TUI /skills list displayed Zero-Base Thinking. Selecting it injected the exact installed body from the user-scope path.
A request through the selected $zero-base-thinking entry read the question guide and opened with a tentative purpose confirmation.

conditions: Only the test child processes used the disposable user-directory setting; the parent environment was not replaced. Both projects had fresh Git directories and no project-local skill copy.
The TUI connected to a dedicated local app-server over a test-owned Unix socket. Separate codex exec sessions exercised natural-language routing and the ordinary edit.
A current ChatGPT login cache was reused locally; the refresh credential was not copied. The test did not cover first-time account sign-in. No credentials are included in this record.
Existing account-synchronized plugins remained available. An unrelated MCP startup warning and a skill-description context-budget notice appeared; this was not an empty-account or plugin-free test.
The natural-language exec used read-only sandboxing; the ordinary-edit exec used workspace-write. Both used approval_policy=never for the test; the TUI used its on-request default.
limits: One observed run per routing case, not a guarantee of deterministic phrase selection.
This verifies Codex CLI on the stated macOS environment, not the desktop app UI, IDE extension, Claude Code, Windows, or Linux.
The installed package is usable across the two test projects; no actual team-meeting outcome or human-perceived benefit was measured.
Persisted model names and client versions are reported where observable. The exact backend build and effective default reasoning effort were not independently exposed.
evidence_normalization: Test directory paths replaced with placeholders.
Installer terminal control sequences and trailing whitespace removed.
Exec traces retain task messages, command/file events, and completion status; credentials and reasoning records are excluded.
